title: Thinking-Free Policy Initialization Makes Distilled Reasoning Models More Effective and Efficient Reasoners
authors_zh: Xin Xu；Clive Bai；Kai Yang；Tianhao Chen；Yang Wang；Saiyong Yang；Can Yang
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时推理轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计测试时 rollout、选择器、反馈信号和计算预算的读者
one_line: An RLVR initialization recipe aimed at reducing explicit reasoning cost while retaining answer-level reward training.
TFPI 以空的 closed-think 前缀初始化策略，在 Polaris-53K 上使用 8 个 RLVR rollout 训练较少显式思考但保持性能的模型。
why: It connects rollout-based policy training to an efficiency goal, but must be documented with verifier, prompt, and rollout lineage rather than only released model checkpoints.
inclusion_reason: It connects rollout-based policy training to an efficiency goal, but must be documented with verifier, prompt, and rollout lineage rather than only released model checkpoints.

title: Problem
问题
html:
RLVR initialized from a distilled long-chain-of-thought model can begin with strong reasoning but produces long rollouts, forcing large training contexts and high collection cost. Simply starting direct RLVR at a short maximum length can truncate useful behavior and, in the paper's meta-experiment, sharply reduce accuracy. The decision problem is therefore how to obtain a cheaper initialization policy without adding a length reward or discarding the slow-thinking capability needed later.

TFPI addresses this between long-CoT distillation and standard RLVR. The underlying data object is an online batch of Polaris-53K prompts, eight policy responses per prompt, token likelihoods, rule-based binary outcome rewards, and multi-stage response-length metadata. The official ICLR 2026 paper, Tencent-Hunyuan repository, Hugging Face checkpoint collection, and TFPI-EVA evaluation dataset are confirmed. They provide code, prompts/checkpoints, and evaluation assets, but not a complete immutable release of every successful and failed rollout, reward record, and optimizer event. The card is therefore L4-ready as a reproducible training recipe with incomplete trace-level lineage.

从蒸馏 long-chain-of-thought 模型开始 RLVR，虽然初始推理能力较强，但 rollout 往往很长，迫使训练使用大 context 并承担高昂采集成本。若直接以很短的最大长度启动 RLVR，又可能截断有用行为；论文的 meta-experiment 中这种设置导致准确率明显下降。因此核心决策问题是：如何获得成本更低的初始化 policy，同时不引入长度奖励，也不丢失后续阶段需要的 slow-thinking 能力。

TFPI 被放置在 long-CoT distillation 与标准 RLVR 之间。其底层数据对象是在线批次中的 Polaris-53K prompt、每题八条 policy 响应、token likelihood、rule-based 二元 outcome reward 和分阶段响应长度元数据。已确认官方 ICLR 2026 论文、Tencent-Hunyuan 仓库、Hugging Face checkpoint collection 与 TFPI-EVA 评测数据。它们提供代码、prompt/checkpoint 和评测资产，但没有完整且不可变地发布所有成功与失败 rollout、reward 记录及 optimizer 事件。因此本卡可作为具备较强复现条件、但 trace-level lineage 不完整的训练 recipe 达到 L4。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
ThinkingFree changes only the formatted input: immediately after the assistant's opening think token, it appends an empty thinking block followed by the closing think control token, so the policy generates its answer without the usual explicit long thinking segment. Ground-truth answers are unchanged. TFPI runs an ordinary RLVR objective on these transformed inputs for a short, staged initialization, then optionally switches back to standard thinking-mode RLVR.

In the reported instantiation, DAPO supplies the optimizer scaffold and a rule-based reward r(x,y) in {0,1}. Eight responses form a group for each prompt; their relative answer-level rewards supply token-shared advantages. TFPI changes the conditioning input and rollout-length schedule, not the verifier or reward function. The resulting data object includes transformed and original prompt forms, sampled responses, binary rewards, group statistics, lengths, and stage/checkpoint identifiers. Compared with direct long-context RLVR, multistage RLVR, and efficiency methods based on special length rewards, the specific contribution is an initialization phase that uses the model's existing chat-template control to collect shorter verifiable rollouts before returning to slow-thinking training.

ThinkingFree 只改变格式化输入：在 assistant 的起始 think token 后直接追加一个空 thinking block 和闭合 think 控制标记，使 policy 不再生成通常的显式长思考段，而直接生成答案。问题的 ground-truth answer 不变。TFPI 在这些变换后的输入上用普通 RLVR objective 进行短期分阶段初始化，之后可切回标准 thinking-mode RLVR。

论文实例使用 DAPO 作为 optimizer scaffold，并采用 r(x,y)∈{0,1} 的 rule-based reward。每个 prompt 生成八条响应组成一组，组内相对答案级奖励为各 token 提供共享 advantage。TFPI 改变的是条件输入与 rollout 长度日程，而不是 verifier 或 reward function。相应数据对象包括变换前后 prompt、采样响应、二元奖励、组统计、长度以及 stage/checkpoint ID。相较 direct long-context RLVR、multistage RLVR 和依赖专门长度奖励的效率方法，其特定贡献是利用模型已有 chat-template 控制，先采集较短的可验证 rollout 完成初始化，再回到 slow-thinking 训练。

title: Method
方法
html:
Training uses DS-1.5B, Qwen3-4B, and DS-7B with Polaris-53K prompts on the VeRL codebase and DAPO. Shared settings are batch size 256, learning rate 1e-6, no warm-up, no KL or entropy loss, temperature 1, top-p 1, top-k -1, and eight rollouts per problem. Direct RLVR uses maximum output lengths of 16K for the 1.5B/7B models and 32K for Qwen3-4B. TFPI instead stages 2K to 4K to 8K for DS-1.5B/DS-7B and 4K to 8K to 16K for Qwen3-4B; the paper reports step and H20-hour budgets for each stage.

At collection time, each original query x is transformed into x' = ThinkingFree(x). The policy samples eight y values conditioned on x'; the same rule-based outcome reward used for x labels each response, and DAPO computes group-relative advantages and clipped token-level updates. A subsequent TFPI+RL condition restores the ordinary thinking template and longer response limit. Evaluation separates math (AIME24/25, BeyondAIME), multi-task reasoning (GPQA-Diamond), code (LiveCodeBench), and instruction following (IFEval), with documented sampling counts and decoding parameters.

The official repository includes training/evaluation scripts, a script that downloads Polaris-53K, TFPI-EVA, and released intermediate and direct-RL checkpoints. Reproduction still requires pinning commits and dataset revisions. The repository does not establish that all online rollout text, rejected samples, reward outcomes, dynamic-sampling decisions, or WandB logs are released.

训练在 VeRL 与 DAPO 上使用 DS-1.5B、Qwen3-4B、DS-7B 和 Polaris-53K prompt。共同设置为 batch size 256、learning rate 1e-6、无 warm-up、无 KL 或 entropy loss、temperature 1、top-p 1、top-k -1，以及每题八条 rollout。Direct RLVR 对 1.5B/7B 模型使用 16K 最大输出长度，对 Qwen3-4B 使用 32K。TFPI 则让 DS-1.5B/DS-7B 按 2K→4K→8K 分阶段训练，让 Qwen3-4B 按 4K→8K→16K 训练；论文逐阶段报告 step 与 H20-hour 预算。

采集时，原始 query x 被变换为 x'=ThinkingFree(x)。policy 在 x' 条件下采样八个 y；与原问题相同的 rule-based outcome reward 为每条响应打标签，DAPO 再计算 group-relative advantage 与 clipped token-level update。后续 TFPI+RL 条件恢复普通 thinking template 和更长响应上限。评测区分数学（AIME24/25、BeyondAIME）、多任务推理（GPQA-Diamond）、代码（LiveCodeBench）与指令遵循（IFEval），并记录不同的采样次数和 decoding 参数。

官方仓库包含训练/评测脚本、Polaris-53K 下载脚本、TFPI-EVA，以及中间阶段和 direct-RL checkpoint。复现仍需固定 commit 与数据 revision；仓库没有证明所有在线 rollout 文本、被拒样本、reward 结果、dynamic-sampling 决策或 WandB 日志均已发布。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Under matched training compute, Table 1 reports that the three TFPI stages improve the overall six-benchmark average for DS-1.5B from 22.0 to 29.2, Qwen3-4B from 60.3 to 63.8, and DS-7B from 42.2 to 47.8, while the matched direct-RL conditions reach 25.3, 60.2, and 43.0 respectively. The paper also reports that the ThinkingFree transformation reduces output tokens by more than 70% in a meta-experiment, and that TFPI initialization lowers rollout lengths during subsequent standard long-CoT RL. The 4B result highlighted in the paper reaches 89.0% on AIME24 and 65.5% on the studied LiveCodeBench subset using under 4K H20 hours for TFPI.

These are model-training and efficiency results under the stated evaluation protocol. They do not prove that short rollouts are faithful explanations, that binary rewards are error free, or that the collected traces form a high-quality dataset. The official repository and checkpoint collection improve reproducibility, but they do not expose a complete item-level trace and reward audit trail.

在匹配训练算力的条件下，表 1 报告三个 TFPI 阶段把 DS-1.5B 的六项 benchmark 总平均从 22.0 提高到 29.2，把 Qwen3-4B 从 60.3 提高到 63.8，把 DS-7B 从 42.2 提高到 47.8；对应 direct-RL 条件分别达到 25.3、60.2 和 43.0。论文还报告 ThinkingFree 变换在 meta-experiment 中使输出 token 减少 70% 以上，并使后续标准 long-CoT RL 的 rollout 更短。论文强调的 4B 模型仅经过 TFPI，在不到 4K H20 hours 下于 AIME24 达到 89.0%，于所研究的 LiveCodeBench 子集达到 65.5%。

这些是指定评测协议下的模型训练与效率结果。它们不能证明短 rollout 是忠实解释、二元 reward 没有错误，或采集轨迹构成高质量数据集。官方仓库与 checkpoint collection 提升了复现条件，但仍未提供完整的 item-level trace 与 reward 审计链。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior multistage RLVR reduces context length progressively but still rolls out ordinary long-thinking prompts; direct short-context RL can truncate the distilled policy's behavior; efficient-reasoning methods often add length rewards or mode-switching objectives. TFPI instead inserts a dedicated initialization stage whose only conceptual intervention is the ThinkingFree input transform, while retaining the same ground-truth reward and DAPO machinery. It then tests whether the initialized policy benefits later normal RLVR.

The direction signal for data curation is that prompt formatting and stage identity materially change the rollout distribution even when prompts, verifier, and optimizer are held fixed. A reusable trace corpus must therefore preserve the exact chat template and whether the sample came from TFPI or ordinary thinking mode. Appending an empty think block, DAPO, Polaris-53K, and multistage length schedules are not individually new; the contribution is their use as a pre-RLVR policy initialization and the matched-compute analysis. Performance gains do not certify the semantic quality or completeness of the released rollout data.

既有 multistage RLVR 会逐步增加 context length，但仍在普通 long-thinking prompt 上采样；direct short-context RL 可能截断蒸馏 policy 行为；不少 efficient-reasoning 方法则加入长度奖励或 mode-switching objective。TFPI 插入专门的初始化阶段，其概念性干预仅是 ThinkingFree 输入变换，同时保留相同 ground-truth reward 与 DAPO 机制，然后检验该初始化是否改善后续普通 RLVR。

对数据整理而言，方向信号是：即使 prompt 内容、verifier 与 optimizer 不变，prompt 格式和阶段身份也会实质改变 rollout 分布。因此可复用轨迹语料必须保留精确 chat template，并标明样本来自 TFPI 还是普通 thinking mode。追加空 think block、DAPO、Polaris-53K 与分阶段长度日程本身并非新组件；贡献在于把它们组织成 pre-RLVR policy initialization，并进行匹配算力分析。性能提升不能证明发布 rollout 的语义质量或完整性。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
TFPI is evaluated on three Qwen-derived distilled or hybrid reasoning models and trains only on Polaris-53K mathematics prompts; transfer to other architectures, chat templates, verifier types, and non-verifiable domains remains uncertain. ThinkingFree depends on the opening and closing think-token conventions of the chat template, so it is not a model-agnostic deletion of internal reasoning. Short visible outputs also do not establish that hidden computation or reasoning faithfulness improved.

The comparisons match reported accelerator hours, but hardware efficiency, sequence utilization, and rollout mixture can still differ between short staged training and long direct RL. Benchmark subsets and multi-sample pass@1 protocols must be preserved when comparing numbers. The official repository has few commits and no tagged release on the inspected page; exact dependency and dataset revisions should be pinned. Checkpoints and evaluation sets are released, but raw successful/failed rollouts, reward logs, prompt-level sampling decisions, licenses for every inherited dataset, and decontamination records are not established as complete.

TFPI 只在三个 Qwen 系蒸馏或混合推理模型上评测，训练数据也仅为 Polaris-53K 数学 prompt；对其他架构、chat template、verifier 类型和不可程序验证领域的迁移仍未知。ThinkingFree 依赖 chat template 的起始与闭合 think 控制标记，因此不是与模型无关的“删除内部推理”。可见输出变短也不能证明隐藏计算或推理忠实性有所改善。

比较匹配的是论文报告的 accelerator hours，但短分阶段训练与长 direct RL 在硬件效率、序列利用率和 rollout mixture 上仍可能不同。比较数字时必须保留 benchmark 子集与多采样 pass@1 协议。所检查的官方仓库 commit 数量较少且页面无 tagged release，依赖和数据 revision 应固定。虽然已发布 checkpoint 与评测集，但成功/失败原始 rollout、reward log、prompt-level sampling 决策、所有继承数据集的许可证和去污染记录均未证实完整。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the rollout/search/test-time trace track, TFPI identifies fields that should accompany efficient-RLVR traces: original prompt, fully rendered chat template, ThinkingFree transformation, base and old-policy checkpoint, stage and maximum length, all eight responses, truncation status, token count, binary verifier result, group reward statistics, importance ratios, optimizer step, and later thinking-mode evaluation. Separating TFPI-stage samples from subsequent standard-RL samples is essential because their conditioning distributions differ.

The official scripts and checkpoints can support controlled studies of how initialization changes rollout length, reward yield, convergence, and cross-domain evaluation. TFPI-EVA is useful for evaluation reproduction, not as evidence that training traces were released. Curators should retain failed and truncated responses rather than treating only successful short answers as the data product, and should keep efficiency metrics separate from correctness and reasoning-quality labels.

对 rollout/search/test-time trace Track，TFPI 指出了 efficient-RLVR 轨迹应附带的字段：原始 prompt、完整渲染 chat template、ThinkingFree 变换、base 与 old-policy checkpoint、stage 与最大长度、全部八条响应、截断状态、token 数、二元 verifier 结果、组内 reward 统计、importance ratio、optimizer step，以及后续 thinking-mode 评测。TFPI 阶段样本必须与后续标准 RL 样本分开，因为二者条件分布不同。

官方脚本与 checkpoint 可支持初始化如何影响 rollout 长度、reward yield、收敛和跨域评测的受控研究。TFPI-EVA 用于评测复现，并不意味着训练轨迹已发布。整理者应保留失败与截断响应，而不是只把成功短答案当作数据产品；效率指标也必须与正确性和推理质量标签分离。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• ThinkingFree appends an empty think block; it does not change the ground-truth answer or reward.
  • Reported TFPI uses DAPO, Polaris-53K, eight rollouts per prompt, and staged length limits.
  • The official repository releases code, evaluation data, and intermediate/direct-RL checkpoints.
  • Raw rollout texts, rejected samples, reward logs, and dynamic-sampling decisions are not established as complete.
  • Lower token use and benchmark gains are not proof of trace faithfulness or data quality.

• ThinkingFree 追加空 think block，不改变 ground-truth answer 或 reward。
  • 论文中的 TFPI 使用 DAPO、Polaris-53K、每题八条 rollout 和分阶段长度上限。
  • 官方仓库发布了代码、评测数据以及中间阶段/direct-RL checkpoint。
  • 原始 rollout 文本、被拒样本、reward log 和 dynamic-sampling 决策未证实完整。
  • token 更少和 benchmark 提升不是轨迹忠实性或数据质量证明。
